title: ThesisRecord
description: The durable output. Maps onto the Notion Investment Thesis / Stock Ticker databases. This is the object the monitor agent re-reads every quarter, so it must be self-contained.

status.description: Must match the Notion select options exactly. Read the schema before writing; never invent an option.

conviction.description: HUMAN-SET. Reflects margin of safety, not growth rate: a fast grower already priced for perfection is lower conviction than a slower grower below its own fair-value range.

sections.description: The standard 7-section write-up. Section 7 present only when advice framing was requested.

s0_disclaimer.description: Educational fundamental analysis, not personalized advice. Stated once, italicized at top.

thesis_hinges_on.description: The one or two things that must be true for the current price to make sense. Usually the real thesis in disguise.

invalidation_triggers.description: Copied from BearCase.kill_criteria. This is what makes the record a tracked position rather than a filed report.

evidence_manifest.description: Full list of evidence ids backing this record, so a future review can tell what was known at authoring time.
